Sifat Al-Huruf in Tajweed - Characteristics of Arabic Letters

Sifat Al-Huruf means characteristics of Arabic letters. After learning WHERE letter comes from (Makharij), you learn HOW it sounds (Sifat). This completes Tajweed for USA & UK beginners.

📖 Free Sifat Chart: Get all Sifat with opposites chart PDF. Claim Free Trial →

What Is Sifat Al-Huruf?

Every Arabic letter has qualities that distinguish it from similar letters. Example: ص and س same Makharij but different Sifat (Tafkheem vs Tarqeeq).

2 Types of Sifat

1. Sifat With Opposites (5 pairs)

  • Hams vs Jahr - Breath running vs stopping - Hams letters: فحثه شخص سكت
  • Shiddah vs Rakhawah vs Tawassut - Sound stopping vs running
  • Isti'la vs Istifal - Elevation (خص ضغط قظ) vs lowering - Heavy vs light
  • Itbaq vs Infitah - Mouth closing - Strong heavy letters ص ض ط ظ
  • Idhlaq vs Ismat - Ease of pronunciation

2. Sifat Without Opposites (7 letters)

  • Qalqala - قطب جد - Bouncing - Learn Qalqala →
  • Safeer - Whistling - ص ز س
  • Leen - Ease - و ي when sakin before
  • Inhiraf, Takreer, Tafashi, Istitalah
